name: Devin
description: Devin is Cognition's AI coding product. The old windsurf.com/pricing address now redirects to devin.ai/pricing, which lists Free, Pro, Max, Teams and Enterprise plans.
features: Unlimited Tab completions and inline edits on the free plan
Access to frontier models from several providers on Pro
Devin Cloud access on paid plans
Extra usage billed at API pricing
strengths: Paid plans can buy extra usage beyond the allowance
limitations: Exact quota figures are not stated

plans.name: Free
highlights: Unlimited inline edits and Tab completions

plans.name: Teams
plans.unit: per team per month, plus $40 per month per full developer seat
plans.billing: $80 per month for the team plus $40 per month per full developer seat
plans.note: Up to 200 users; centralized billing, admin dashboard and priority support.

free.details: Light quota to code with agents; limited model availability; unlimited inline edits and Tab completions.

verification.notes: Product active (now an editor plus cloud agents). Free $0; Pro $20/month; Max $200/month; Teams is $80/month for the team plan plus $40/month per full developer seat (up to 200 users); Enterprise by demo. Corrected: Teams was stored as $40 per user only; the $80 team base was missing. Paid plans have daily and weekly usage allowances; extra usage is bought at API pricing.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

keyFeature: AI coding agents and an editor

profile.headline: An autonomous software engineer that works in the cloud or on your machine

capabilities.title: Take on an engineering task end to end
capabilities.text: Devin plans a feature, fixes bugs or performs a security scan, and keeps going until the pull request is ready to merge.

capabilities.title: Test its own work
capabilities.text: It runs on its own Windows, Mac and Linux virtual machines, tests in its own browser and records itself clicking through what it built.

capabilities.title: Run many tasks in parallel
capabilities.text: A big task can be split across parallel cloud agents, which Devin manages and reports back on.

capabilities.title: Respond where your team talks
capabilities.text: Tag Devin in Slack, Teams and similar tools; it reads the thread and answers follow-ups.

featureCards.name: Automations
featureCards.text: Set Devin to handle bugs, failed CI and alerts as they arrive.

featureCards.name: Wiki
featureCards.text: Maps a codebase and its architecture, and updates diagrams and code maps as the code changes.

featureCards.name: Review
featureCards.text: Reviews pull requests and explains its own analysis of a change.

featureCards.name: Sessions
featureCards.text: Each task is a session you can pin, follow and join as a teammate.

featureCards.name: Works when you close your laptop
featureCards.text: Long tasks continue in the cloud.

featureCards.name: Choice of models
featureCards.text: The site shows a model picker, including a mode that pairs a lead model with a cheaper helper.

audienceDetail.text: The site is written for teams that want a teammate that opens pull requests.
Alert and incident response is shown with a PagerDuty example.
Dependency upgrades and architecture documentation are among the examples.

scenarios.title: Add enterprise single sign-on
scenarios.text: The site's main example adds SAML SSO following existing authentication patterns, then tests it in the browser.

scenarios.title: Fix a bug reported in Slack
scenarios.text: Devin fixes it and adds a regression test, then links the pull request.

scenarios.title: Respond to a production alert
scenarios.text: Devin finds the deployment behind an error spike and prepares a fix.

scenarios.title: Keep dependencies current
scenarios.text: Weekly upgrades of frameworks such as React and Next.js, each ending in a pull request.

gettingStarted.step: Get started or book a demo
gettingStarted.text: Both buttons are on the homepage.
Plan a feature, fix bugs or run a security scan, or @-mention Devin in Slack or Teams.
Check what it changed, the tests it ran and the recording of its browser session.
